meta.coordinateUnit: projected metre; east x, north y
meta.lengthUnit: approximate ground metre using cos(sample latitude)
meta.capacityUnit: relative service units per 15 minutes; not vehicles
meta.constructionSelection: Author-selected short sample work zones on named roads; not announced 2050 projects.
limitations: Local extract covers selected highway classes only, not all streets or complete Shanghai.
Nodes connect only shared source coordinates with matching level/bridge/tunnel context; arbitrary geometric crossings are not connected.
Conservative level separation can disconnect true bridge/tunnel portals; no portal repair or routing certification performed.
No source node IDs are present; coordinate-derived candidate node IDs are used.
Lanes/oneway/maxspeed tags are incomplete; defaults and relative capacity are explicit author assumptions.
A road graph is not an observed OD matrix, road traffic count or calibrated traffic forecast.
